families.status_en: Existing original UI adapter; selected firmware versions verified. Original hardware/kernel boot is not emulated.
families.status_zh: 保留原厂 UI 适配器，指定固件版本已验证；尚未模拟原厂硬件及原厂内核启动。
families.boot_gap_en: Sensor, ISP, lens and camera peripherals are mocked or absent.
families.boot_gap_zh: 传感器、ISP、镜头等相机外设为模拟值或尚未实现。

families.status_en: A7 IV 2.00 Linux 4.9.186-scel+ and A7R V 4.00 Linux 4.9.337-scel boot with their original ext2 rootfs to verified root shells. Original camera UI has not booted.
families.status_zh: A7 IV 2.00 的 Linux 4.9.186-scel+ 和 A7R V 4.00 的 Linux 4.9.337-scel 均使用原厂 ext2 根文件系统进入经过验证的 root shell；原厂相机 UI 尚未启动。
families.boot_gap_en: Development DTB, single core, timer/register models and USB initcall blacklist are required. Original init now passes DMA initialization but faults in cryptEmmc_setKeyCovertly. Secure storage/bootloader handoff, eMMC, proprietary IPC and display remain missing.
families.boot_gap_zh: 使用开发 DTB、单核、定时器/寄存器模型及 USB initcall 黑名单。原厂 init 已通过 DMA 初始化，随后在 cryptEmmc_setKeyCovertly 异常；仍缺安全存储/引导交接、eMMC、专有 IPC 和显示适配。

families.family: GR III / IIIx / IV frame container
families.status_en: GR III 2.10, IIIx 1.60 and IV 1.11 original Linux/rootfs shells are verified. GR IV additionally runs original TopMenu and Focus settings with native Confirm/Back in an assisted QEMU UI lab integrated into the workbench.
families.status_zh: GR III 2.10、IIIx 1.60 和 IV 1.11 的原厂 Linux/根文件系统 shell 已验证。GR IV 另已辅助运行原厂 TopMenu 与 Focus 设置页，原生确认/返回通过，并接入工作台 UI 实验室。
families.boot_gap_en: Original UI uses a separately built software-display platform, explicit startup adaptation and native transition completion. Full RTOS cold boot, animation timers, physical LCD, capture and Linux/RTOS IPC remain unverified. GR III/IIIx camera UI remains unverified.
families.boot_gap_zh: 原厂 UI 使用独立构建的软件显示平台、明确记录的启动适配与原生过渡完成函数。完整 RTOS 冷启动、动画计时、物理 LCD、拍摄和跨核 IPC 未验证；GR III/IIIx 原厂相机 UI 未验证。

families.family: XOR-table update packages / selected Z models
families.status_en: Six Z-series packages decrypted and checked. Separate assisted QEMU builds verify Z7 C3.80 and Z30 C1.20 menus/submenu return, plus Z6 C3.80 Playback menu DOWN/UP selection.
families.status_zh: 六份 Z 系列升级包已解密并校验；独立辅助启动 QEMU 已验证 Z7 C3.80、Z30 C1.20 原厂菜单与子菜单返回，以及 Z6 C3.80 回放菜单的向下/向上选择。
families.boot_gap_en: Keys and custom QEMU are separate local inputs. Assisted startup calls original functions and changes guest RAM. Natural power-on, full imaging hardware and other Z models are not boot verified.
families.boot_gap_zh: 密钥与定制 QEMU 单独配置；辅助启动调用原厂函数并改变 guest RAM。自然开机、完整成像硬件及其他 Z 机型尚未验证启动。

upstreams.license: GPL-2.0-or-later; separately installed, assisted UI verified
GPL-2.0-or-later; separately installed, assisted menu verified; LCD scanout unverified

families.status_en: EOS 50D 1.0.9 original DryOS updater executes in qemu-eos. Main-image cryptographic derivation is checked against the updater; actual payload decryption requires a ROM1 seed.
families.status_zh: EOS 50D 1.0.9 原厂 DryOS 升级程序已在 qemu-eos 执行；主固件密钥派生已与原升级程序交叉验证，真实载荷解密仍需 ROM1 种子。
families.boot_gap_en: Low-vector boot prelude and synthetic ROMs allow updater bring-up only. Missing ROM properties/fonts cause a font assertion. Full ROM0/ROM1 and the original ROM1 seed are required for main-firmware/UI research.
families.boot_gap_zh: 低向量引导前导与合成 ROM 仅让升级程序启动；缺失 ROM 属性/字体导致字体断言。主固件和 UI 研究仍需完整 ROM0/ROM1 与原 ROM1 种子。

families.status_en: X3 original Linux 4.9.76 and SquashFS rootfs boot to a verified root shell using an independent H22 board. Extraction checks MD5/CRC; other encrypted formats remain unsupported.
families.status_zh: X3 原厂 Linux 4.9.76 与 SquashFS 根文件系统已在独立 H22 板型进入经过验证的 root shell；解包验证 MD5/CRC，其他加密格式尚未支持。
families.boot_gap_en: Development DTB, UART/register model and GIC reset setup are required. Original init reaches S99bootdone, then RPMsg faults without its RTOS partner. Original UI, imaging and storage controllers are absent. Luna MWFI remains unsupported.
families.boot_gap_zh: 使用开发 DTB、UART/寄存器模型与 GIC 复位设置；原厂 init 到达 S99bootdone 后因缺 RTOS 对端而在 RPMsg 异常。原厂 UI、成像与存储控制器尚未实现，Luna MWFI 仍未支持。

families.status_en: Exact fp 5.02 official update extracts a 49,481,728-byte ARM MAIN image. Outer and packed byte sums, load extents and full output SHA-256 are verified against original IPL decoder execution.
families.status_zh: 精确匹配 fp 5.02 官方升级包，提取 49,481,728 字节 ARM 主程序；外层及压缩段字节和、装载范围与输出哈希均已核验，并与执行原厂 IPL 解压函数的结果一致。
families.boot_gap_en: Original reset, RTOS peripherals and UI remain under development. Other revisions are inspection-only; extraction does not establish boot support.
families.boot_gap_zh: 原厂复位启动、RTOS 外设与 UI 仍在开发；其他版本仅分析，解包通过不代表启动成功。

upstreams.license: GPL-3.0; native memory/function references, source not copied

families.status_en: Exact official HERO8 2.51 UPDATE.zip or DATA.bin imports the original RTOS. Original Tara camera, VIDEO presets and native Back roundtrip are verified in one assisted QEMU instance.
families.status_zh: 精确匹配 HERO8 2.51 官方 UPDATE.zip 或 DATA.bin，导入原厂 RTOS；同一辅助启动 QEMU 实例内已验证原厂 Tara 拍摄页、VIDEO 预设菜单与原生返回。
verified_samples: HERO8 Black HD8.01.02.51.00 (assisted original Tara UI)
families.boot_gap_en: Separate QEMU platform required. Original UI component entry bypasses proprietary RTOS tasks; 20 RAM veneers provide software display, heap, mutex and clock. Finite deferred-free heap. Full cold boot, sensor and recording are unverified.
families.boot_gap_zh: 需要独立 QEMU 平台；原厂 UI 组件入口绕过专有 RTOS 任务，20 处 RAM 适配提供软件显示、内存、互斥锁和时钟。堆空间有限，回收延迟到会话结束；完整冷启动、传感器和录制未验证。

upstreams.license: GPL-2.0 and included licenses; independent local board overlay
